The storage change dialog
§12 R26, state by state — reached from the Settings Storage group's Change… (see settings.html) after the OS picker. One dialog: current path → new path, the required Migrate / Start-fresh choice, the safety facts in place, and a single arm-then-confirm commit that names the relaunch. The pipelines behind it are §20 R12 (database) and §20 R13 (backup folder); refusals surface inside the dialog and the config file is untouched until the commit.
As opened. Neither choice is pre-selected and the commit is disabled — the required choice is the comprehension gate (§12 R26). Cancel is always live.

Refused in place. Migrate never overwrites (§20 R12): an existing destination file stops the pipeline; the reason renders inside the dialog in the danger block palette (§12 R21), the dialog stays open, the config untouched, the old location still active.

A file already exists at /home/kirby/tracking/timetracker.sqlite — migrate never overwrites. Pick a different location, or choose Start fresh to adopt the existing file (it must pass the integrity and version checks). Nothing has changed.
The backup folder variant. Same dialog, move semantics (§20 R13): a fresh backup lands in the new folder first, existing backups are moved and verified, and a failed verify aborts with both sets intact.
